name: AppleEnrollmentTypeProfile
label: Deploy Apple Enrollment Type Profile
helpText: Creates and manages an Apple user-initiated enrollment type profile (such as iOS/iPadOS web based device enrollment) and keeps it assigned to the configured groups. The tenant needs an Apple MDM push certificate for the enrollment itself to function.
executiveText: Ensures every tenant offers the same enrollment experience for Apple devices, such as web based enrollment for personal iPhones and iPads, without engineers configuring each tenant by hand.
docsDescription: One instance per profile display name. Grades the enrollment type, description and available enrollment type options from the cached Apple user-initiated enrollment profiles plus - separately - the group assignment through Compare-CIPPIntuneAssignments. Remediation repairs a wrong assignment in place, patches drifted settings, and only sets the priority when the profile is first created.

Priority.label: Priority (applied when the profile is created)

customGroup.label: Custom group name(s). Comma separated, wildcards allowed.
